action.query: Wells Fargo credit card login official
queries: Wells Fargo credit card login official

content.text:
To log in to your **Wells Fargo credit card account**, use the official Wells Fargo sign-on through **WellsFargo.com** or the Wells Fargo Mobile app.

**Safe steps:**
1. Go to **WellsFargo.com** by typing it directly into your browser.
2. Click **Sign On**.
3. Enter your username and password.
4. If you’re not enrolled, choose **Enroll** to set up online access.

Wells Fargo’s cardholder page says you can manage your account online, pay your bill, set up alerts, get paperless statements, and sign on with Wells Fargo Online. ([retailservices.wellsfargo.com](https://retailservices.wellsfargo.com/customer/?utm_source=openai))

**Security tip:** Don’t use random “Wells Fargo credit card login” links from emails/texts/search ads. Go directly to WellsFargo.com or use the official mobile app.
